mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and corporate profits, driving S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points in the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last two months signals a strengthening housing market, which typically leads to increased economic activity and consumer confidence, driving S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the previous two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to decreased corporate profits and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which typically supports higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to increased economic activity and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points and PAYEMS increased by more than 1% in the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary environment with easing monetary policy, which typically leads to increased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% in 1 month AND CPIAUCSL decrease > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both FEDFUNDS decreased by more than 0.25% and CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a high level of GDP (GDPC1) during a period of economic expansion signals strong economic fundamentals, which typically leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average during a period of economic expansion.
